correctness.rationale: At exactly harmonic degree 2, normalized spherical harmonics with azimuthal orders -2..2 give five columns. Each of the two m-point rings annihilates every nonzero order difference of absolute value <=4 when m>=5. Thus Gram is diagonal irrespective of second-ring azimuthal phase, with (5m/8pi) times A=(3u-1)^2 once, B=6u(1-u) twice, C=3(1-u)^2/2 twice. On 0<u<1 only u=1/3 is singular. Comparing C/B below the smaller A=B crossing, C/A up to 1/3, B/A to 2/5 and B/C thereafter gives unique u=(6-sqrt(21))/15 and squared condition (5+sqrt(21))/4. An independently constructed raw complex spherical-harmonic 14x5 evaluation Gram at m=7 and nonzero twist matched the full diagonal to 2.3e-16; checked optimizer and rank boundary algebra. These finite tests corroborate exact orthogonality and rational inequalities.
